name: bent_beam_actuator
title: Transient response of a bent-beam electrothermal actuator
summary: Joule-heated bent-beam actuator discretised into six nodes along one side of the beam: transient nodal energy balances (conduction, uniform Joule generation, convection) integrated over 25 ms, apex displacement from the thermal elongation, compared with the analytical fin solution of example 1.7-1.
language_features: array elements indexed by a variable outside loops (not supported by CoolSolve)

origin.notes: Example 3.8-1 of Nellis & Klein, Heat Transfer, Cambridge University Press, 2009, from the EES example set of F-Chart Software (raw example: https://fchartsoftware.com/ees/examples/examples_heat_transfer_2009/chapter%203/example%203.8-1%20transient%20response%20of%20a%20bent-beam%20actuator.eez, saved by EES X11.911). Plain-text mirror published under MIT by EES-Community/ees-examples (commit 5c703d0); the stored solution was extracted from ees-examples-raw/uncategorized/example_3.8-1_transient_response_of_a_bent-beam_actuator.eez of the same repository.

verification.summary: Runnable variant, temperatures in °C, compared with the EES stored solution (.eez, --ees-units): 64 common variables, 5 differ. Stored temperatures and the apex displacement agree (the temperature diffs are below 0.001). The five stored dTdt differ by 9.07e-03 relative: conduction and Joule terms of about 2.4e5 K/s nearly cancel.
verification.reference: Stored solution of ees-examples-raw/uncategorized/example_3.8-1_transient_response_of_a_bent-beam_actuator.eez (EES-Community/ees-examples), extracted with tools/ees_extract.py
verification.notes: compare_solution.py vs the stored CSV: 64 common variables, 5 differ (rtol=0.001), all five the dTdt rates at 9.07e-03; only in EES: 6 (the five variables of the dead commented block and the loop index i, stored as inf); only in CoolSolve: pi. Verified criterion of the card: stored temperatures (max 2.3e-7) and apex displacement (3.0e-7) agree.

history.action: added (T-IMPORT card C-519, candidate EEX-019 of the ees_examples inventory); native file blocked by CS-GAP-INTEGRAL-DUPLICATE, CS-GAP-LINE-CONTINUATION and CS-GAP-INDEX-VAR, runnable variant bent_beam_actuator_coolsolve.eescode verified against the EES stored solution
